items.title: How NASA and the Artemis II crew completed the 'perfect' splashdown
items.description: Nine days, one hour, 32 minutes and 15 seconds, a journey deeper into space than ever before and a rapt Earth watching on. This is how four astronauts made history.

items.title: Live: JD Vance arrives in Pakistan for peace talks with Iran
items.description: US Vice-President JD Vance has arrived in Islamabad, Pakistan to enter into peace talks with Iran. Follow live.

items.title: Israel's mass killing has forced Trump to think about Lebanon
items.description: For weeks, Israel has been intensifying its deadly strikes across Lebanon, and Donald Trump has had little to say. But now he has been forced to make it a priority.

items.title: Thai fishing port highlights 'big trouble' caused by Middle East war
items.description: Tens of thousands of small and commercial fishing vessels in Thailand are stranded on shore, no longer able to afford diesel, which has more than doubled in price since the Iran war began.

items.title: A look at the sea mines Iran claims are in the Strait of Hormuz
items.description: Iran claims to have littered a central shipping passage in the Strait of Hormuz with sea mines, in a move analysts say could be a "coercive threat" to maintain its grip on the crucial waterway.

items.title: 'Sounds good to me': How Trump was sold war in Iran
items.description: Extraordinary reporting reveals how Israel made the case for regime change in Iran — and how the fallout is driving a profound shift in American opinion, amid deep uncertainty about what the war has achieved.

items.title: Live: Bombers end record losing streak, Sydney lead Gold Coast
items.description: North Melbourne faces its toughest challenge of the season so far against defending premiers Brisbane, while winless Essendon takes on the Demons. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Baffling Bunker call denies Roosters a try
items.description: The Roosters chances of pulling off a comeback win over the Sharks have taken a blow following a questionable call from the Bunker. Follow live.

items.title: Three dead after car hits tree in Perth Hills
items.description: Three people have died after a vehicle left the road and hit a tree in the Perth Hills suburb of Stoneville.

items.title: Lying immobile after a remote chopper crash, Fred felt something biting his leg
items.description: In the aftermath of a 2019 helicopter crash in Kakadu National Park, Fred Hunter lay on the ground covered in blood and fuel, when he felt something biting his leg. On the 20th anniversary of CareFlight, Mr Hunter recounts his dramatic rescue by the service.

items.title: Hollingsworth sensationally reinstated as national champion after initial DQ
items.description: The twists and turns of the women's 1,500 metres final at the Australian Athletics Championships continue, with Claudia Hollingsworth winning her appeal against her disqualification after favourite Jess Hull crashed out.

items.title: Three men arrested, weapons seized after police chase in Sydney's west
items.description: The occupants of the allegedly stolen Audi threw fuel jerry cans from the car onto the M4 Motorway while trying to evade police, officers say.

items.title: Debra Adelaide's best friend died by suicide. She wrote a novel about her
items.description: Debra Adelaide became friends with Gabrielle Carey when they were 12. After Carey died by suicide five decades later, Adelaide tried to address her unanswered questions in a novel.

items.title: This rich, meat-free curry is a budget-friendly way to make a massaman
items.description: Mushrooms are a cost-effective way to make a hearty massaman that is also vego and vegan-friendly.

items.title: ABC 50/50 quiz: A classic poem, oyster recipes and Itchy and Scratchy
items.description: Every question has only two options: one is right, and the other is wrong. You have an even chance of guessing correctly each time.

items.title: Fans living it up in Adelaide for Gather Round but future of event uncertain
items.description: Occupancy rates and food and drink sales are up on last year's Gather Round, says the Australian Hotels Association, despite concerns fuel prices would deter interstate visitors.

items.title: War hero's looming prosecution divides opinion
items.description: Once celebrated as Australia's most decorated living war hero, the looming prosecution of Ben Roberts-Smith is shaping up to be the next trial of the century.

items.title: High Court has made Bruce Lehrmann's defamation case a complete failure
items.description: The High Court was Bruce Lehrmann's last legal avenue to challenge a Federal Court ruling that, on the balance of probabilities, he raped Brittany Higgins — now that avenue has closed.

items.title: Man dead as house destroyed in fire in Brisbane's south
items.description: Emergency services were called to a house fire on the corner of Foote and Annear streets in Acacia Ridge, where a man's body was found.

items.title: Maila may be just a tropical low by the time it reaches Australia
items.description: After causing damage to islands in the Pacific, Cyclone Maila is downgraded as it heads towards Australia.

items.title: Teen shuns screens to turn love of chickens into growing egg business
items.description: While many teenagers spend their spare time online gaming or playing sport, 14-year-old Max Lye hangs out with a bunch of chooks and dreams of owning his own egg farm.

items.title: Milk prices may need to increase to cover soaring fuel and fertiliser costs
items.description: Dairy farmers across Australia are battling crippling fuel and fertiliser costs. The industry is now calling for a 30-cent-per-litre rise in milk prices on supermarket shelves.

items.title: McIlroy's 'just keep swinging' approach takes him to huge Masters lead
items.description: Jason Day does not do a lot wrong in the second round at Augusta National, but Rory McIlroy is looking just about untouchable after two rounds of the Masters.

items.title: Australians less likely to get bypass surgery now than 20 years ago
items.description: John Ross may be Australia's longest surviving double bypass patient. Here's how has the cardiac operation has evolved over the past 50 years.

items.title: UK man jailed for abusing girl may face renewed visa cancellation
items.description: A British child sex offender who avoided deportation is facing a possible visa review, after an ABC investigation.
